notes.title: Post-PGA update to Project Bridge released! 🏗️
notes.notes:
[h2]Release 1.1.19 Notes[/h2]

Thanks for all the feedback during PGA - the Poznań Games Arena 2024 fair, which is the largest gaming event in Poland. It was so much fun to meet many of you on our stand, play together and talk about the game 💖

We took all of your suggestions from the event to heart and release this update with the following changes to Project Bridge:

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a blueprint when building a bridge to make the building process more intuitive.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the way in which the characters' rotation is set in order to make it easier to move around.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the 'Start game' button, which is now responsive to the number of players.
[*]Fixed an error where the game would return to the main menu after a game has been going on for an extended period of time.
[/list]

As always thanks for your continued support and feedback, have fun 🧡

Btw there's still some time to grab the game during the Autumn Sale! 🍂

notes.title: Major update to Project Bridge released! 🔥
notes.notes:
[h2]Release 1.1.10 Notes[/h2]

[b]New[/b]
[list]
[*]Added new medieval city level.
[*]Added new castle level.
[/list]
[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Some UI changes.
[*]Desert level difficulty has been balanced by increasing the number of available cacti and slowing down the speed of tornadoes.
[*]Increased visibility of resources in the cave level.
[*]Optimization of the game's performance.
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with sounds activating at the wrong time.
[*]Various minor bugfixes.
[/list]

Thanks for your continued support and feedback, have fun  🧡

notes.title: PLAYING OUR CO-OP PROJECT BRIDGE!
notes.notes: Project Bridge is a fun co-op endless runner that can be played in couch mode or multiplayer adventure with up to 4 people. Gather resources, build bridges over procedurally generated terrains, upgrade your character's skill set and run as far as you can before the mysterious void swallows you!
